reviewContract.occurrenceRule: A wrapped heading is one occurrence made of every participating source line; preserve all line ids and its source span.

detailed source TOC/Table-of-Forms entries matched back to expected body pages

method.modelRole: GPT-5.6 Sol defined/reviewed semantic structural rules; Python enumerated source identities and performed deterministic reconciliation

limitations: Two-column ITP headings sometimes share a PDF source line with body text; their occurrence is line-grounded and logical heading text is preserved from the source TOC.
Fine-grained unlisted headings in contract tables may be under-recalled.
